WPFInstallglazewm.description: GlazeWM is a tiling window manager for Windows inspired by i3 and Polybar.

WPFInstallOverwolf.description: CurseForge is a desktop application for managing mods and modpacks across multiple games, powered by Overwolf.

WPFInstallOFGB.description: GUI Tool to remove ads from various places around Windows 11

WPFInstallZenBrowser.description: The modern, privacy-focused, performance-driven browser built on Firefox.

WPFInstallZed.description: Zed is a modern, high-performance code editor designed from the ground up for speed and collaboration.

WPFInstallzotero.description: Zotero is a free, easy-to-use tool to help you collect, organize, cite, and share your research materials.

WPFInstalldeskflow.description: Deskflow is a free and open-source software KVM that lets you share a single keyboard and mouse across multiple computers.

WPFInstallRuby.description: A Ruby language execution environment with a MSYS2 installation.

WPFInstallLua.description: A 'batteries included environment' for the Lua scripting language on Windows.

WPFInstallCloudflareWARP.description: WARP is a freemium VPN service provided by Cloudflare. Includes usage of Cloudflare's DNS

WPFInstallwintoys.description: A modern Windows 10 and 11 utility from the Microsoft Store offering system optimization, cleanup, service management, health tools, and tweaks in a clean interface.

WPFInstall.Description: Install or upgrade the selected applications

WPFInstallUpgrade.Description: Upgrade all applications to the latest version

WPFGetInstalled.Description: Detects and selects which of the 240 catalog apps are already installed. For all Windows Add/Remove Programs, use 'System & Health -> Installed Apps'.

WPFInstallFOSSInfo.Description: Information about the #FOSS label on application entries

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsFeedbackHub.Description: Allows users to submit bug reports, feature suggestions, and diagnostic data directly to Microsoft.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_GetHelp.Description: Provides access to automated troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and direct Microsoft customer assistance.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_OutlookForWindows.Description: Provides modern email management, calendar scheduling, and contact organization features.

WPFAppxMSTeams.Description: Facilitates instant messaging, video conferencing, file sharing, and workspace collaboration.

WPFAppxClipchamp_Clipchamp.Description: Provides a user-friendly video editor with built-in templates, effects, and timeline editing tools.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_MicrosoftOfficeHub.Description: Serves as a centralized launcher and dashboard for accessing cloud-based Microsoft 365 apps and recent documents.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_ZuneMusic.Description: Plays local audio and video files with modern playlist management and casting capabilities.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_BingSearch.Description: Integrates Microsoft Bing search capabilities and web services directly into the operating system.

WPFAppxMicrosoftCorporationII_QuickAssis.Description: Enables secure remote technical support and screen sharing over an internet connection.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsDevHome.Description: Provides a specialized dashboard for software developer environment setups, repository syncing, and hardware widgets.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsCrossDevice.Description: Manages system-level background connectivity with paired mobile devices. Removing this may disable cross-device features such as phone screen mirroring, file transfer, and mobile hotspot handoff integrated into Windows Settings.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_Todos.Description: Creates, tracks, and synchronizes personal tasks, smart lists, and daily reminders.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_PowerAutomateDesktop.Description: Automates repetitive workflows and desktop tasks using low-code visual scripting.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_YourPhone.Description: Synchronizes text messages, phone notifications, photos, and calls from a mobile device to the desktop.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_MicrosoftStickyNotes.Description: Creates quick, floating text notes on the desktop that automatically sync across devices.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsSoundRecorder.Description: Records and trims live audio inputs with simple microphone adjustment controls.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsAlarms.Description: Features world clocks, alarms, countdown timers, stopwatches, and dedicated focus session tracking.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_Paint.Description: Provides built-in digital sketching, basic image editing, and pixel-level graphic manipulation tools.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsNotepad.Description: Provides a lightweight text editor with multi-tab support for plain text files and code snippets.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_ScreenSketch.Description: Captures screenshots or screen recordings with built-in markup, image cropping, and optical character recognition (OCR).

WPFAppxMicrosoft_Copilot.Description: Launches the Microsoft AI companion for contextual answers, creative writing assistance, and intelligent web search.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsCalculator.Description: Performs standard arithmetic, scientific operations, programming calculations, and unit conversions.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsCamera.Description: Captures photographs and records video files via connected webcams or imaging hardware.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_WindowsPhotos.Description: Organizes, views, and crops local images with basic color adjustment and album creation tools.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_BingNews.Description: Aggregates breaking news headlines, personalized article feeds, and world current events.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_BingWeather.Description: Displays local real-time weather tracking, radar maps, and historical meteorological forecasts.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_GamingApp.Description: Serves as the primary gaming library manager, social community interface, and PC Game Pass dashboard.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_XboxGamingOverlay.Description: Provides customizable in-game status widgets, audio balancing sliders, system monitoring tools, and gameplay recording.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_XboxIdentityProvider.Description: Manages Xbox network user authentication and background account validation for connected titles. Warning: removing this may break Microsoft account sign-in for non-Xbox games and apps that rely on this authentication pipeline.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_XboxSpeechToTextOverlay.Description: Provides system-level live accessibility captions and voice-to-text translation for gaming chat networks.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_Xbox_TCUI.Description: Provides core account connection UI modules for single sign-on flows within game titles. Warning: removing this may break Microsoft account authentication in games and apps that do not otherwise require the Xbox app.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_StartExperiencesApp.Description: Powers the Windows Widgets board, delivering a personalized feed of news, weather, sports, and finance content.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_MicrosoftSolitaireColle.Description: Bundles built-in card game modes including Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, and TriPeaks alongside daily challenges.

WPFAppxMicrosoft_ZuneVideo.Description: The default video player and storefront for purchasing or renting media.

WPFFeaturesdotnet.Description: .NET and .NET Framework is a developer platform made up of tools, programming languages, and libraries for building many different types of applications.

WPFFixesNTPPool.Description: Replaces the default Windows NTP server (time.windows.com) with pool.ntp.org for improved time synchronization accuracy and reliability.

WPFFeatureshyperv.Description: Hyper-V is a hardware virtualization product developed by Microsoft that allows users to create and manage virtual machines.

WPFFeatureslegacymedia.Description: Enables legacy programs from previous versions of Windows.

WPFFeaturewsl.Description: Windows Subsystem for Linux is an optional feature of Windows that allows Linux programs to run natively on Windows without the need for a separate virtual machine or dual booting.

WPFFeaturenfs.Description: Network File System (NFS) is a mechanism for storing files on a network.

WPFFeatureRegBackup.Description: Enables daily registry backup, previously disabled by Microsoft in Windows 10 1803.

WPFFeatureEnableLegacyRecovery.Description: Enables Advanced Boot Options screen that lets you start Windows in advanced troubleshooting modes.

WPFFeatureDisableLegacyRecovery.Description: Disables Advanced Boot Options screen that lets you start Windows in advanced troubleshooting modes.

WPFFeaturesSandbox.Description: Windows Sandbox is a lightweight virtual machine that provides a temporary desktop environment to safely run applications and programs in isolation.

WPFTweaksActivity.Description: Stops Windows from publishing or uploading user activities while preserving clipboard history.

WPFTweaksHiber.Description: Hibernation is really meant for laptops as it saves what's in memory before turning the PC off. It really should never be used.

WPFTweaksWidget.Description: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.

WPFTweaksRevertStartMenu.Description: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!

WPFTweaksDisableStoreSearch.Content: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableStoreSearch.Description: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.

WPFTweaksServices.Description: Sets some services to Manual startup.

WPFTweaksSvcHostSplitting.Description: Disables service-host splitting to reduce the number of svchost.exe processes and modestly lower memory overhead. Recommended for low-performance systems with 12 GB of RAM or less. Can interfere with Xbox services. Restart Windows after changing this setting.

WPFTweaksBraveDebloat.Description: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.

WPFTweaksDisableWarningForUnsignedRdp.Description: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

WPFTweaksEdgeDebloat.Description: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.

WPFTweaksConsumerFeatures.Description: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.

WPFTweaksDeliveryOptimization.Description: Stops Windows from using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs on the internet or local network.

WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.Description: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.

WPFTweaksUTC.Content: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
WPFTweaksUTC.Description: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.

WPFTweaksRemoveOneDrive.Description: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.

WPFTweaksRemoveHomeAndGallery.Content: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
WPFTweaksRemoveHomeAndGallery.Description: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.

WPFTweaksDisplay.Content: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
WPFTweaksDisplay.Description: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.

WPFTweaksReservedStorage.Description: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

WPFTweaksRestorePoint.Description: Creates a restore point at runtime in case a revert is needed from WinUtil modifications.

WPFTweaksEndTaskOnTaskbar.Content: End Task With Right Click - Enable
WPFTweaksEndTaskOnTaskbar.Description: Enables option to end task when right-clicking a program in the taskbar.

WPFTweaksStorage.Description: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.

WPFTweaksWindowsAI.Description: Removes and disables all AI features/packages

WPFTweaksWPBT.Description: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.

WPFTweaksPreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwor.Description: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. Ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

WPFTweaksRazerBlock.Description: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.

WPFTweaksLogiBlock.Description: Blocks the Logi Download Assistant that Windows Update keeps reinstalling with Logitech device drivers. Logitech hardware keeps working without it.

WPFTweaksBlockAdobeNet.Description: Reduces user interruptions by selectively blocking connections to Adobe's activation and telemetry servers. Credit: Ruddernation-Designs

WPFTweaksRightClickMenu.Description: Attempts to restore the classic Windows 11 File Explorer context menu on newer builds. Compatibility may vary.

WPFTweaksDiskCleanup.Description: Runs Disk Cleanup on Drive C: and removes old Windows Updates.

WPFTweaksIPv46.Description: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.

WPFTweaksTeredo.Description: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.

WPFTweaksDisableSearchIndexing.Description: Stops and disables the Windows Search service (WSearch) to cut background disk activity, mainly useful on mechanical hard drives. Warning: file searches in Explorer and the Start menu become much slower because Windows no longer maintains a search index. Undo restores the service and starts it again.

WPFTweaksDisableBGapps.Description: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.

WPFTweaksDisableExplorerAutoDiscovery.Content: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
WPFTweaksDisableExplorerAutoDiscovery.Description: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.

WPFToggleDetailedBSoD.Description: Gives more information when you blue screen.

WPFToggleBatteryPercentage.Description: Shows numeric battery percentage next to the battery icon in the system tray.

WPFToggleDarkMode.Description: Dark Mode for the system and applications.

WPFToggleNewOutlook.Description: This will ensure the new Outlook application is used.

WPFToggleScrollbars.Description: If enabled, scrollbars will always be visible. If disabled, Windows will automatically hide scrollbars when not in use.

WPFMultiplaneOverlay.Description: Multiplane Overlay composes multiple image layers, which can sometimes cause issues with graphics cards. Changes to this preference are applied immediately.

ComboDescriptions.Disabled (Compatibility): Disables MPO using OverlayTestMode=5, the less aggressive compatibility method.
ComboDescriptions.Fully Disabled: Disables MPO using OverlayTestMode=5 and DisableOverlays=1, the more aggressive method.

WPFToggleMouseAcceleration.Description: Makes it so Cursor movement is affected by the speed of your physical mouse movements.

WPFToggleNumLock.Description: Toggle the Num Lock key state when your computer starts.

WPFToggleWindowSnapping.Description: Toggles the window snapping feature when dragging windows.

WPFToggleStandbyFix.Description: Toggles network connectivity during S0 Sleep which is low power idle in modern laptops.

WPFToggleS3Sleep.Description: Toggles between Modern Standby and S3 Sleep, which cuts off power to the CPU while continuing to refresh the memory.

WPFToggleHideSettingsHome.Description: Toggles the Home Page in the Windows Settings app.

WPFToggleBingSearch.Description: Toggles Bing web search results in Windows Search.

WPFToggleLoginBlur.Description: Toggles the acrylic blur effect on login screen background.

WPFToggleDisableLockscreen.Description: Skips the lock screen entirely and goes directly to the sign-in screen on boot and wake.

WPFToggleStartMenuRecommendations.Description: Toggles the recommendations section in the Start Menu. WARNING: This will also disable Windows Spotlight on your Lock Screen as a side effect.

WPFToggleStickyKeys.Description: Toggles the Sticky Keys, which activate when clicking shift rapidly.

WPFToggleTaskbarAlignment.Description: Toggles the Taskbar alignment either to the left or center.

WPFToggleTaskbarSearch.Description: Toggles the Search Button on the Taskbar.

WPFToggleTaskView.Description: Toggles the Task View Button in the Taskbar.

WPFToggleGameMode.Description: Toggles Windows prioritizes gaming performance by allocating system resources to games.

WPFToggleLongPaths.Description: Toggles support for file paths longer than 260 characters in Explorer.

WPFOOSUbutton.Description: Downloads O&O ShutUp10++ (about 82 MB) from oo-software.com on every click and launches it. Nothing is installed; the file is saved under %LocalAppData%\winutil.

WPFchangedns.ComboItems: Default DHCP Fastest Google Cloudflare Cloudflare_Malware Cloudflare_Malware_Adult Open_DNS Quad9 AdGuard_Ads_Trackers AdGuard_Ads_Trackers_Malware_Adult
WPFchangedns.Description: Changes DNS servers for active network adapters. Selecting 'Fastest' benchmarks latency and picks the fastest DNS automatically.

ui.Win11Does2: Bypasses the TPM, Secure Boot, CPU, RAM and storage checks
ui.Win11Does3: Skips the Microsoft account screen so you can use a local account
ui.Win11Does4: Turns off telemetry, Copilot, the chat icon and search box suggestions
ui.Win11Does5: Pins the edition you picked above so Setup does not choose another one
ui.Win11Step3Sub: Save the modified image as an ISO file, or write it straight to a USB drive you can boot from.

ui.SysBtnQuickClean: Quick Junk, TEMP, Shader & Recycle Bin Cleanup
ui.SysActionReady: Ready. All toggles reflect your live system state.
ui.SysBtnBrowserClean: Clean Browser Caches (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Firefox / Opera)
ui.SysPingPlaceholder: Click to measure live latency (ms) to Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard and Quad9.
ui.SysStartupMgrSub: Enable or disable Windows startup apps with one click (100% Task Manager compatible).
ui.SysTipBatteryReport: Runs powercfg /batteryreport and opens the detailed battery health report in your browser.
ui.SysTipHAGS: Offloads GPU memory scheduling to hardware to reduce gaming latency (requires restart).
ui.SysTipVBS: Virtualization-based security. Keep enabled for security, or disable for higher gaming FPS (requires restart).
ui.SysTipFastStartup: Saves kernel state on shutdown for faster boot. Disable if dual-booting Linux/Windows.
ui.SysTipGameMode: Limits background updates and notifications during gameplay and prioritizes game CPU usage.
ui.SysTipWindowedGames: Reduces input lag in windowed/borderless games and improves VRR & Auto HDR support.
ui.SysTipMPO: Disable and restart if you experience Alt+Tab stutters or video flickering on NVIDIA/AMD GPUs.
ui.SysTipGameDVR: Disabling background game recording can improve FPS stability in games.
ui.SysTipAnimations: Disabling window animations makes windows open and close instantaneously.
ui.SysTipTransparency: Toggles translucent acrylic/mica effects on the taskbar and menus.
ui.SysTipCleanRam: Trims idle process working sets to immediately free up available system RAM.
ui.SysTipRestartGpu: Safely resets the display driver using Windows' built-in Win+Ctrl+Shift+B hotkey.
ui.SysTipQuickClean: Cleans user/system TEMP, DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD shader caches, Prefetch, and Recycle Bin.
ui.SysTipBrowserClean: Cleans browser cache folders only — passwords, bookmarks, and active sessions are untouched.
ui.SysTipCleanWinUpdate: Temporarily stops Windows Update services and safely clears SoftwareDistribution\Download.
ui.SysTipCleanDrivers: Safely removes superseded unused OEM driver packages from DriverStore (keeps active drivers).
ui.SysTipWinSxS: Runs DISM /StartComponentCleanup to safely reclaim disk space from old Windows updates.
ui.SysTipOptimizeDrive: Runs TRIM on SSDs or defragmentation on HDDs for drive C:.
ui.SysTipSystemRepair: Scans and repairs corrupted Windows system files using DISM + SFC.
ui.SysTipDefenderScan: Starts a quick malware scan using built-in Windows Defender.
ui.SysTipStoreReset: Fixes Microsoft Store launch failures or stuck app downloads via wsreset.exe.
ui.SysTipRepairIcons: Rebuilds the Windows icon cache to fix blank or corrupted desktop/app icons.
ui.SysTipNetReset: Resets Winsock, TCP/IP stack, and DNS cache to fix connectivity or speed issues.
ui.SysTipGodMode: Creates a special Desktop folder collecting all Windows Control Panel & admin settings in one place.

ui.SysAppsSubtitle: Lists all programs installed on Windows; safely scans and removes leftover Registry (Regedit), AppData, and TEMP files after uninstall.
ui.SysLblDeepClean: Scan Registry + AppData + TEMP leftovers after uninstall
ui.SysTipDeepClean: When enabled, leftover folders, Registry keys, and TEMP files are scanned after uninstall and removed with your confirmation.
